MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
[C. M L. A's]
(Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th duly 1977)
No. 9
Any person who attacks, resists
or injures, or causes to be attacked, resisted, or injured any member of the
forces whether civil or military or any civil official, shall be punished,
Maximum punishment death.
